subject: Acupuncture Together Business Profile
overview: The Medford Bytes podcast interviewed Justine Myers, owner of Acupuncture Together, regarding the business's relocation to Medford. The discussion focused on the community acupuncture model, which utilizes group treatment and sliding scale pricing to increase healthcare accessibility.

items.title: Introduction and Local Favorites
items.summary: Host Danielle Balocca introduced Justine Myers, who shared her favorite Medford restaurants including Chili Garden and El Vaquero.

items.title: Business Relocation and Regulation
items.summary: Justine Myers described the history of Acupuncture Together and its 2021 move from a hidden office in Cambridge to a visible storefront in Medford.

items.title: Community Acupuncture Model
items.summary: The practice treats patients in a shared space using recliner chairs and distal point techniques, allowing patients to remain clothed while receiving treatment.

items.title: Sliding Scale Pricing and Insurance
items.summary: The clinic offers a sliding scale of $25 to $50 per session and does not bill insurance to ensure treatment remains affordable for those with chronic conditions.

items.title: Clinical Conditions and Methodology
items.summary: Myers detailed common conditions treated, such as chronic pain and anxiety, and explained the neurological responses triggered by acupuncture needles.

items.title: History of Community Treatment
items.summary: The discussion explored the origins of the community acupuncture movement in the United States and the cultural standard of group treatment in China.
